title: Ten frames, one room
technique: Ten real-looking photos lock each moment in order; Seedance only fills the motion between.
story: A bikini store owner gets a refund and is tempted to post a discount.
Scout, a floating lime orb, freezes time and says she is missing something.
Inside the orb she watches a past call with one of her shoppers.
The shopper says the store runs a discount every week, so she waits for it.
Stunned, the owner deletes all her discounts. Days later a full-price order arrives.
End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.

She reads the phone and deflates
